records.summary: The manifesto distinguishes the first mandate's sovereign asset and monetary policy from a second mandate to build an open, transparent liquidity engine for tokenized stocks, rather than another stock issuer. It proposes creating or approving markets, seeding liquidity, coordinating external capital and returning trading fees to the Reserve to fund more markets. Dated market examples motivate the strategy; reserve-position panels are explicitly samples.
